slot_scores.name: mandatory_bob_selection
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether any child, especially Bob, was mandatory, and did not mark this as an assumption needing confirmation.

slot_scores.name: alice_diana_conflict_rule
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask about any conflict or mutual-exclusion rule involving Alice and Diana, nor did it explicitly flag this as an unconfirmed assumption.

slot_scores.name: minimize_total_cost_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: What is the goal for the selection — should I minimize total cost, or just list all valid combinations?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the objective and confirmed whether it should minimize total cost.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: No child is mandatory; Bob is optional and can be excluded.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked whether Bob or any child must be selected, then proceeded to model and solve without that constraint.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: There is no conflict between Alice and Diana; they may be selected together if otherwise feasible.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about Alice-Diana incompatibility and did not mark it as an assumption, yet omitted the constraint from the model.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent entered READY_TO_MODEL after resolving the P0 objective slot but while P1 hidden slots H1 and H2 remained unasked and unresolved.

summary: The agent confirmed the minimization objective but stopped prematurely without asking about the mandatory Bob selection or the Alice-Diana conflict rule, silently omitting both P1 constraints from its model.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
